findings.summary: The e2e red-target test injects the single transport failure through the sealer's durable-ref push (op=push) rather than the ls-remote named in the spec's injection-point note; same transport closed set, same verbatim GnuTLS fixture, same retry executor, and red-target assertions 1-5 are vehicle-agnostic and all mechanically asserted. Re-verified at final phase.

The control-plane read-side ls-remote probe and the replayer's trim-time ls-remote/push run under DEFAULT_EGRESS_POLICY without an explicit fence_seconds (bounded by the 5-attempt budget); both are auxiliary paths outside stage execution that degrade to unverified/refuse rather than faulting, and every stage-path call site is fenced by its stage run fence (dd_runner.py:319,357). Re-verified at final phase.

supervise/harvest_ops.py still runs raw remote fetch/push outside the retry wrapper; these sit in the harvest supervision reactor, outside the dd stage execution path that 交付面 1's per-stage attempt budget and run-fence clauses bind, keep their own report/refuse semantics, and cannot terminalize a dd order. Noted for scope traceability only.
